App.input: No props; reads browser session on mount.
App.work: Owns user, loading, error, loggingOut, and audioBusy state. The mount effect calls loadUser, ignores late results after unmount, and chooses loading, Login, or AudioWorkspace. Audio busy state disables logout.
App.output: Rendered top-level UI; session-expired callback clears user and shows the login screen.

App.handleLogin.work: Calls loadUser to fetch the authenticated account, rejects missing sessions, clears the error, and stores the user.
App.handleLogin.output: App transitions to the authenticated workspace; failures propagate to the sign-in button.

App.handleLogout.work: Sets loggingOut, clears errors, awaits logout, and clears user only on success. Displays a readable error on failure and resets the busy state in finally.

Login.work: Renders the login screen and GoogleLoginButton; forwards the callback. Decorative feature cards and waveform have no processing logic.

GoogleLoginButton.work: Keeps the latest callback in a ref. On mount, initializes the available Google Identity SDK with VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and renders its button. Tracks pending/error feedback; if SDK or button ref is absent, initialization returns.
GoogleLoginButton.output: Google sign-in button and request feedback.

GoogleLoginButton.handleCredentialRespon.work: POSTs JSON to API_URL + /auth/google with cookies included, checks HTTP success, then awaits the latest App onLogin callback. Catches errors and clears pending in finally.
GoogleLoginButton.handleCredentialRespon.output: Login cookies from backend and refreshed App user state, or a visible login error.

AudioWorkspace.work: Owns selected file, language, saved job, job ID, recording/pending state, limits, and feedback. Its mount effect loads server limits; failure is ignored because the server still enforces limits. Forms delegate to upload, lookup, and download handlers.
AudioWorkspace.output: Recorder, upload form, saved-job lookup, transcript, timestamp list, and downloads.

AudioWorkspace.runAction.input: Status message and an async action callback.
AudioWorkspace.runAction.work: Returns if disabled or already in flight. Uses a ref to block overlapping actions immediately, resets feedback, marks busy, awaits action, routes SessionExpiredError to App, and resets all busy flags in finally.
AudioWorkspace.runAction.output: Completed action or visible error; no overlapping form requests.

AudioWorkspace.handleUpload.input: Upload form submit and currently selected File/language.
AudioWorkspace.handleUpload.work: Prevents navigation, rejects missing/empty/oversize files, and uses runAction to await uploadAudio. Stores returned job and ID and displays a success notice.
AudioWorkspace.handleUpload.output: SavedJob shown in the result section; error feedback if upload fails.

AudioWorkspace.handleLookup.input: Saved-job form submit and jobId text.
AudioWorkspace.handleLookup.work: Prevents navigation, trims the ID, ignores empty values, and uses runAction to call loadAudioJob.
AudioWorkspace.handleLookup.output: Existing owned job loaded into the result section.

AudioWorkspace.handleDownload.work: Uses runAction to fetch an original or exported transcript Blob, creates a temporary object URL and download link, clicks and removes the link, then schedules URL revocation after one second.
AudioWorkspace.handleDownload.output: Browser download and success notice; filenames strip client path components for originals.

AudioRecorder.work: Owns active/error/preview state and recorder/stream/timer refs. Mount cleanup stops capture, clears timeout, and marks component unmounted; preview effect revokes replaced object URLs. Its media-event callbacks assemble the File.
AudioRecorder.output: Microphone controls and a local audio preview; onReady passes the recorded File upward.

AudioRecorder.start.input: Start recording click; configured byte and duration limits.
AudioRecorder.start.work: Prevents duplicate starts, checks browser support, requests microphone access, chooses supported WebM/MP4/Ogg MIME type, registers media callbacks, and starts one-second chunk capture. Clears the previous selected file and schedules duration stop. Releases tracks after cancellation, unmount, or errors.
AudioRecorder.start.output: Active MediaRecorder, chunks collected locally; no audio upload yet.

AudioRecorder.stop.input: Stop button, duration timer, or recorder-error path.
AudioRecorder.stop.work: Marks the attempt cancelled; stops an active recorder and its media tracks. If microphone permission is still pending, resets UI/busy state so a late stream is released by start.
AudioRecorder.stop.output: Recorder's final data and stop events complete file assembly.

fetchUser.input: No arguments; browser cookies and API_URL.
fetchUser.work: GETs /auth/me. On 401 POSTs /auth/refresh, returns null for refresh 401, rejects other refresh failures, then retries /auth/me once. Final 401 returns null; other non-success responses throw.
fetchUser.output: User or null, or an account/session error.

loadUser.work: Shares an in-flight fetchUser request among callers. Waits for an ongoing logout and returns null instead of refreshing. Clears userRequest in finally.
loadUser.output: Promise<User | null>; avoids duplicate refreshes from concurrent checks.

logout.work: Shares concurrent logout calls, waits for any pending user/refresh request to finish (ignoring its failure), then POSTs /auth/logout with cookies. Throws on non-success and clears logoutRequest in finally.
logout.output: Resolved promise after logout or a retryable error.

authenticatedFetch.work: Rejects while logout is running. Forces credentials: include, sends the request, and on 401 calls loadUser before retrying the original request once. Missing session or a second 401 throws SessionExpiredError.
authenticatedFetch.output: Response; non-401 HTTP errors remain for the caller to handle.

checkResponse.input: Response from an audio API request.
checkResponse.work: Returns for success. Otherwise attempts JSON decoding, uses a string detail if available, and falls back to a generic error message.
checkResponse.output: No value on success; throws Error for failed HTTP responses.

uploadAudio.work: Creates FormData with file and nonblank trimmed language, calls authenticatedFetch for /audio/upload, checks response, and maps nested upload metadata/transcription into the UI SavedJob shape. Lets browser set multipart boundaries.
uploadAudio.output: SavedJob with text, segments, language, size, duration, status, and ID.

loadAudioJob.work: URL-encodes the ID, GETs /audio/{id} with authenticatedFetch, checks errors, and parses JSON.

loadAudioLimits.work: GETs /audio/limits using authenticatedFetch, checks the response, and parses JSON. The backend route itself is public.

downloadTranscript.work: GETs /audio/{id}/export/{format}, checks HTTP errors, and reads a Blob.
downloadTranscript.output: Text/subtitle Blob ready for the browser download handler.
